title: AidEscrow Deployment Registry
description: Machine-readable source of truth for on-chain AidEscrow deployments (contract IDs and initialization configuration). One entry per deployment, ordered oldest to newest.

$schema.description: Optional relative path to this schema so editors can validate the registry.

schema_version.description: Version of this registry file format.

deployments.description: Deployment records, ordered oldest to newest.

network.description: Stellar network the contract was deployed to.

wasm_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the uploaded WASM (64 hex characters).

deployer.description: Public key of the deploying account (56-character G... strkey).

init_args.description: Arguments passed to init() at deployment time.

git_commit.description: Git commit SHA of the source build. Null for legacy entries recorded before commit tracking.

version_tag.description: Git tag for the release, e.g. "v0.1.0-testnet".

record.description: Path (relative to app/onchain) to the human-readable deployment record markdown.
